title: Subprocess environment closure

environment.system_features: ACL GMP GNUTLS LIBSELINUX LIBXML2 MODULES NATIVE_COMP NOTIFY INOTIFY PDUMPER SECCOMP SQLITE3 THREADS TREE_SITTER ZLIB

mechanism: Emacs subprocesses must inherit the same controlled environment contract as the Emacs process.
hypothesis: A shell subprocess should see the Insula allowlist variables, private directories, and no host package-manager leakage such as conda, mamba, `PYTHONPATH', or ambient `LD_LIBRARY_PATH'.
predicted_behavior: The subprocess environment should stay within the declared allowlist for the current development Insula.

independent_checks.name: subprocess has no host package-manager leakage
subprocess sees the same Insula run id

counterexample: A clean Emacs process can still launch subprocesses with leaked host variables if the process environment is mutated later.
derived_gym_requirement: Every benchmark subprocess, including LSP servers, Jupyter kernels, Comint shells, and checkers, must prove environment closure before task output is trusted.
